_comment: Matrixyl 3000 Pro Collagen Full & Firming Cream, 2026-08-21. Jar wording read off refs/product_tight.png; carton read off refs/box_coloured_face.png and box_silver_face.png. The 2026 artwork spells 'TRIPLE COLLAGEN' correctly - the RETIRED design on the live store reads 'TRIPPLE'. Quote the new spelling.
product_desc: Skingenetix Matrixyl 3000 Pro Collagen Full & Firming Treatment cream: a 50ml frosted NEUTRAL WHITE glass cosmetic jar, wide and squat - noticeably WIDER THAN IT IS TALL, about 1.15 times wider than its full height - with a deep brushed satin aluminium screw lid. The glass is a clean cool white with no colour cast at all - never tinted teal, green, blue or grey. The lid is a tall band standing about a THIRD of the jar's total height and roughly HALF the height of the glass body beneath it; it is not a thin disc or a shallow cap. The lid metal is NEUTRAL SILVER-GREY with a fine brushed grain, never rose-gold, copper, champagne or a chrome mirror. Reproduce the front label exactly as in the reference, every character verbatim. The colour words below describe the INK each line is printed in and must never themselves appear as text on the product: the Skingenetix DNA-helix mark and the 'Skingenetix' wordmark in BLACK, spelled with a CAPITAL 'S' and the rest lower case, with no registered-trademark, copyright or any other symbol anywhere near it; a narrow vertical DEEP TEAL rule down the left of the text block; 'MATRIXYL 3000 PRO COLLAGEN' in BLACK bold capitals; 'FULL & FIRMING TREATMENT' in DEEP TEAL bold capitals; 'PREMIUM FORMULA' in MID-GREY capitals; and the fine print line 'MATRIXYL 3000 | TRIPLE COLLAGEN | ELASTIN | 50ML' in MID-GREY capitals. Spell it 'TRIPLE', with one P in the middle - never 'TRIPPLE'. THE JAR CARRIES ONLY THE LINES LISTED ABOVE - not the benefit words and not 'ALL SKIN TYPES'. Those are carton-only. BRAND ACCENT COLOUR: DEEP TEAL. Any brand colour, gradient or accent glow builds from that teal and cool neutrals - never gold, rose, purple, orange or blue.
_packaging_desc_help: The carton teal is a deep emerald-teal, sampled #205952 off the dieline. The cream carton is a squat wide box, unlike the tall slim serum carton.
packaging_desc: The product carton is a squat rectangular box, wider than it is tall, with crisp square edges and a matte finish. It has TWO different printed faces and both may appear: one face is a DEEP EMERALD-TEAL panel with a soft gradient, the other is a MATTE-SILK SILVER panel - never mirror chrome, never foil-shiny. On the TEAL face, printed in WHITE: the Skingenetix DNA-helix mark and the 'Skingenetix' wordmark, then 'MATRIXYL 3000' and 'PRO COLLAGEN' in bold capitals, then 'FULL & FIRMING TREATMENT', then the line 'PLUMPING | FIRMING | VOLUMIZING', then 'PREMIUM FORMULA | ALL SKIN TYPES', and the fine print 'MATRIXYL 3000 | TRIPLE COLLAGEN | ELASTIN | 50ML'. On the SILVER face the same wording appears with the headline lines in DARK GREY and 'FULL & FIRMING TREATMENT' in DEEP TEAL. Spell it 'TRIPLE', with one P in the middle. No colour name appears as text anywhere on the box.
